name: Deborah
bio: Deborah was Rebekah's nurse. Scripture mentions her only briefly, at her death: she was buried beneath an oak near Bethel, which Jacob named Allon-bachuth, meaning "oak of weeping" (Genesis 35:8). Though Scripture says almost nothing else about her life, the fact that her death and burial place were specifically recorded suggests she was a deeply respected and beloved elder within Rebekah and Jacob's household. (Not to be confused with the later prophetess and judge Deborah in the book of Judges.)
